note: Pins for every file copied from another repository. `blob` is `git hash-object --no-filters <localPath>`. Where the upstream ledger attested the file, `attestation.contentHash` is that ledger's hash and `topicMetaBlob` is the one other input it covered, so the upstream digest can be re-derived here without the upstream repository: printf '%s %s\ntopic_meta %s\n' <path> <blob> <topicMetaBlob> | git hash-object --stdin
